name: @atd/macos
description: Native macOS shell (Swift/AppKit). Requires Xcode 26, XcodeGen and SwiftLint.

scripts.format: swift format --in-place --recursive --parallel Package.swift App Sources Tests Widgets
scripts.format:check: swift format lint --strict --recursive --parallel Package.swift App Sources Tests Widgets
scripts.build:release: pnpm run bundle && node scripts/build.mjs --configuration Release
scripts.bundle: pnpm -w exec turbo run build --filter=@atd/agent-service... --filter=@atd/agent-client && pnpm --filter @atd/desktop build && node scripts/prepare-service-pack.mjs
